```{r, results="hide", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
source("data_wrangling/create_analysis_df.R")
```


```{r}

analysis_df_factors = analysis_df_factors |> 
  filter(bmi < 45)

descr_table = tbl_summary(
  analysis_df_factors |> 
  mutate(
    smoking = if_else(smoking == "0", "Unknown", smoking)
  ),
  by = country_code,
  include = c(
    # sex,
    # day_of_week,
    # avg_acc_AGSA,
    # IG_AGSA,
    weekend,
    holiday,
    weekend_or_holiday,
    # age,
    # bmi,
    # smoking,
    # secondary_prevention_yn,
    # comorbidities_n,
    # medications_n,
    # cardiomyopathy,
    # myocardialinfarction,
    daily_temperature_2m_max_oe,
    daily_precipitation_hours,
    daily_sunshine_duration_hours_oe,
    daily_wind_speed_10m_max,
    event_icd
  ),
  type = list(
    # comorbidities_n ~ "continuous",
    # medications_n ~ "continuous",
    weekend ~ "dichotomous",
    holiday ~ "dichotomous",
    weekend_or_holiday ~ "dichotomous",
    # cardiomyopathy ~ "dichotomous",
    # myocardialinfarction ~ "dichotomous",
    event_icd ~ "dichotomous"
  ),
  value = list(
    weekend ~ "1",
    holiday ~ "1",
    weekend_or_holiday ~ "1", 
    # cardiomyopathy ~ "1",
    # myocardialinfarction ~ "1",
    event_icd ~ "1"
  ),
  digits = all_continuous() ~ 2
) |> 
  add_overall()

write_csv(as.data.frame(descr_table), "analysis/descriptives/descr_table_day.csv")

# print(descr_table)
```



```{r}

analysis_df_factors_participant = analysis_df_factors |> 
  mutate(
    smoking = if_else(smoking == "0", "Unknown", smoking),
  ) |> 
  group_by(Participant) |> 
  mutate(
    has_event = any(event_icd == "1")
  ) |> 
  distinct(Participant, .keep_all = TRUE)

descr_table_participant = tbl_summary(
  analysis_df_factors_participant,
  by = country_code,
  include = c(
    sex,
    # # day_of_week,
    # avg_acc_AGSA,
    # IG_AGSA,
    # weekend,
    # holiday,
    age,
    bmi,
    bmi_factor,
    smoking,
    secondary_prevention_yn,
    comorbidities_n,
    medications_n,
    cardiomyopathy,
    myocardialinfarction,
    # daily_temperature_2m_max_oe,
    # daily_precipitation_hours,
    # daily_precipitation_hours,
    # daily_sunshine_duration_hours_oe,
    # daily_wind_speed_10m_max,
    # event_icd,
    has_event
  ),
  type = list(
    comorbidities_n ~ "continuous",
    medications_n ~ "continuous",
    # weekend ~ "dichotomous",
    # holiday ~ "dichotomous",
    cardiomyopathy ~ "dichotomous",
    myocardialinfarction ~ "dichotomous"
    # event_icd ~ "dichotomous"
    # has_event ~ "dichotomous"
  ),
  value = list(
    # weekend ~ "1",
    # holiday ~ "1",
    cardiomyopathy ~ "1",
    myocardialinfarction ~ "1"
    # event_icd ~ "1"
    # has_event ~ "1"
  )
) |> 
  add_overall()

write_csv(as.data.frame(descr_table_participant), "analysis/descriptives/descr_table_participant.csv")
```

```{r}

analysis_df_factors_participant_pa = analysis_df_factors |> 
  mutate(
    smoking = if_else(smoking == "0", "Unknown", smoking),
  ) |> 
  group_by(Participant) |> 
  mutate(
    has_event = any(event_icd == "1")
  ) |> 
  summarise(across(starts_with("IG_") | starts_with("avg_acc_"), ~ mean(.x)), country_code = first(country_code))

descr_table_participant_pa = tbl_summary(
  analysis_df_factors_participant_pa,
  by = country_code,
  include = c(
    avg_acc_AGSA,
    avg_acc_ENMO,
    avg_acc_MAD,
    avg_acc_MIMS,
    avg_acc_CountsVM,
    IG_AGSA,
    IG_ENMO,
    IG_MAD,
    IG_MIMS,
    IG_CountsVM,
  ),
  digits = list(starts_with("IG") ~ 3, avg_acc_MIMS ~ 3)
) |> 
  add_overall()

write_csv(as.data.frame(descr_table_participant_pa), "analysis/descriptives/descr_table_participant_pa.csv")

# print(descr_table_participant_pa)
```
